name: VetoBot – AI Scraper & Bot Blocker for Artists

sections.description:
As digital creators, your portfolio is your livelihood. VetoBot gives artists a frictionless, 2-click solution to block unauthorized AI bots from scraping their WordPress websites for training data.

The Free Version automatically shields your site from the most aggressive public crawlers.

🚀 Need Ultimate Protection?
Upgrade to VetoBot Pro to deploy an advanced real-time firewall that blocks over 30+ AI scrapers, tech giants, and hidden data thieves.
Learn more and get PRO at: https://vetobot.carrd.co

Free Features

  • Instant Protection: Automatically blocks major crawlers like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini.
  • Made for Artists: Zero technical coding required. Install, activate, and shield your portfolio.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folders to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the VetoBot settings page to ensure protection is active.
